name.fr-FR: Institutions liturgiques, tome III : Les livres de la Liturgie
name.en-US: Liturgical Institutions, Volume III: The Books of the Liturgy
name.pt-BR: Instituições litúrgicas, tomo III: Os livros da Liturgia

description.fr-FR: Troisième volume de la seconde édition : préface, deuxième partie (Les livres de la Liturgie, chapitres I-VIII : importance, antiquité, langue, traduction, publication et correction, manuscrits et imprimés, ornements) et Lettre à Mgr l’archevêque de Reims sur le droit de la Liturgie.
description.en-US: Third volume of the second edition: preface, second part (The books of the Liturgy, chapters I-VIII: importance, antiquity, language, translation, publication and correction, manuscripts and printed books, ornaments) and the Letter to the Archbishop of Rheims on the right of the Liturgy.
description.pt-BR: Terceiro volume da segunda edição: prefácio, segunda parte (Os livros da Liturgia, capítulos I-VIII: importância, antiguidade, língua, tradução, publicação e correção, manuscritos e impressos, ornamentos) e Carta ao arcebispo de Reims sobre o direito da Liturgia.

fr-FR.editor: Société générale de librairie catholique, Victor Palmé (Paris)

sources.edition: Institutions liturgiques, 2nd ed., tome III, Paris, Société générale de librairie catholique, Palmé
sources.description: archive.org OCR (djvu.xml word coordinates used to drop running heads, marginal notes and page-foot notes from the body; page-foot notes became footnotes where their markers could be matched; the chapter notes stay as the closing section of each chapter). sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875; text first published in his lifetime (1840-1851) and reprinted by 1885.
